title: Principal Technical Support Engineer (Remote)
description:
In our 'always on' world, we believe it's essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.

We are excited to announce that we are hiring a Principal Technical Support Engineer in working from Brazil remotely to join our team and provide high‑level technical expertise to our Ruckus Premium (BullDog) customers.

Your primary responsibility is to serve as a key technical resource, delivering expert assistance and ensuring prompt resolution of complex customer issues.

How You'll Help Us Connect the World:

You work directly with customers to troubleshoot problems, isolate root causes, and drive cases to closure with a high level of technical accuracy and professionalism. When needed, you reproduce customer scenarios in the Support Lab to validate findings and deepen understanding of the issue.

You collaborate closely with Engineering teams to manage escalations, resolve product bugs, and ensure that long-term corrective actions are identified and implemented. Throughout each case, you provide consistent updates to sales teams, internal management, and customers, maintaining clear communication and transparency at every stage.

Given the nature of the role, you are expected to support a staggered work week when required (such as Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday) and participate in a rotating on-call schedule. Flexibility in work hours is essential to accommodate urgent customer needs. You thoroughly document customer interactions, engineering engagements, and action plans to ensure high-quality case management and knowledge continuity.

Beyond case handling, you contribute to the organization by creating and refining knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, and internal training materials. You provide mentoring and coaching to team members to help strengthen overall team capability. You also participate regularly in customer and internal conference calls for high-profile cases and escalations, ensuring issues receive appropriate visibility. All responsibilities are carried out with strict adherence to Service Level Agreement KPIs.

Required Qualifications for Consideration:

  • 8+ years of experience working in the networking space
  • 5+ years of experience working in a TAC
  • Excellent written and oral communication ability, including formal presentation skills to customers, partners, Ruckus accounts and support teams
  • Excellent understanding and applied knowledge of TCP/IP, L3 routing, L2 switching, Multicast, firewalls, QOS
  • Solid understanding and troubleshooting skills with wireless technologies 802.11x, WLAN authentication, encryption, EAP, PSK, Radius, AAA, DNS
  • Expertise of wireless deployments – AP’s, Controllers, Client associations, etc
  • Excellent understanding of RF transmission and antenna behavior
  • Technical expertise in troubleshooting and resolving complex Layer 2/3 and/or wireless issues in multi-vendor environments
  • Experience providing support to direct customers, resellers, and field personnel in resolving company product related issues
  • Ability to provide technical guidance to other members in the team
  • Experience working in a support lab environment for problem replication
  • Experience documenting the sequence of events related to resolving customer technical issues
  • Proficient with analyzing data traces from protocol analyzers such as Wireshark
  • High level of English.
  • Available Monday through Friday or ‘staggered work week’s, i.e. Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday and weekend or overnight hours as required.

Important Candidate Notice : On January 9, 2026, CommScope finalized the sale of its Connectivity and Cable Solutions segment, which included the CommScope name and brand, to Amphenol Corporation. The remaining businesses — Access Networks Solutions (now rebranded as Aurora Networks ) and RUCKUS Networks have been unified under the new parent company, renamed as Vistance Networks . The role being advertised is part of RUCKUS Networks.

Why Join Us?

Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology, pushing past what is possible. We deliver solutions that bring reliability and performance to a world always in motion. Our global team of innovators and employees are trusted advisors who listen to customers first, then deliver value.

RUCKUS Networks delivers purpose-driven enterprise networks that enable superior business outcomes in demanding environments. Our solutions combine AI-powered automation, proactive network assurance, and context-aware security, providing exceptional performance with simplified management.

If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next…..come connect to your future at Vistance Networks.

Vistance Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), including people with disabilities and veterans.

title: Engenheiro de IA
description:
Engenheiro de IA

Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro de IA para atuar em uma fábrica de software consolidada, com mais de 30 anos de atuação no mercado , participando da construção e evolução de soluções avançadas baseadas em Inteligência Artificial e GenAI.

Buscamos um profissional com forte base técnica, pensamento científico e capacidade de projetar arquiteturas escaláveis de IA, garantindo qualidade, segurança, rastreabilidade e eficiência no uso de modelos de linguagem e sistemas inteligentes.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

• Conduzir o método científico em GenAI: formulação de hipóteses, desenho de experimentos, avaliação estatística e tomada de decisão baseada em evidências.

• Projetar e evoluir a arquitetura de IA com foco em RAG/LLMs, escalabilidade, rastreabilidade, explicabilidade, custo e latência.

• Definir, acompanhar e melhorar métricas de qualidade: recuperação (recall/precision, nDCG), factualidade, utilidade, segurança, latência e custo por requisição.

• Elaborar e refinar engenharia de prompts em cenários complexos, com guardrails e práticas de segurança contra prompt injection, exfiltração e jailbreaks.

• Garantir compliance e anonimização de dados sensíveis em linha com LGPD e regulamentações do setor público, com auditoria e trilhas de decisão.

• Documentar experimentos, resultados e boas práticas, promovendo transparência e reprodutibilidade; comunicar insights técnicos e executivos com clareza.

• Evangelizar o uso responsável e eficiente da IA representando a empresa em talks, artigos e comunidades técnicas.

Requisitos e qualificações (obrigatórios):

title: Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer

What you’ll do

  • Design, develop, and optimize data pipelines and distributed data systems
  • Build and maintain ETL workflows across multiple systems
  • Lead analytics modules and communicate technical outcomes clearly
  • Partner with consulting teams to define delivery outcomes and technical approach
  • Deliver production-ready solutions (from prototype to enterprise-grade systems)

Technical Requirements – Required

  • Python and SQL
  • Relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB or similar)
  • NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Redis, Neo4j or similar)
  • Distributed systems (Spark / PySpark / Hadoop)
  • Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

Nice to Have

  • Airflow, Data Factory, Glue, Prefect, Dagster
  • Snowflake / Star schema modeling
  • Kafka / streaming frameworks
  • Docker / Kubernetes
  • Azure Data Lake Storage
  • Data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker)
company: Microtalent is becoming INSPYR Global Solutions

title: Consultor Sênior - Engenheiro Elétrico - Auditoria Interna(GRC)
description:
Como trabalhar na Grant Thornton?

Aqui o aprendizado e o desenvolvimento são constantes. E o nosso espírito colaborativo faz toda a diferença para o seu crescimento individual e conquistas em equipe.

Nossos tempos são formados por pessoas e talentos, com trajetórias, habilidades únicas. Inovação que diversidade é essencial para o fortalecimento da nossa organização e dos nossos colaboradores, refletindo em melhores, promovendo e continuados para nossos clientes.

Se você é uma pessoa movida a desafios e determinado a fazer a diferença. Faça parte da nossa equipe!


Principais Responsabilidades/Atividades

  • Coordenar trabalhos de consultoria, auxiliando e engajando a equipe;
  • Demonstrar habilidade de planejamento;
  • Realizar treinamentos on-the-job de Trainees e Associates;
  • Executar controles analisando e identificando falhas internas;
  • Execução de processos, matriz de riscos e controles, condução de testes, elaboração de planos de ação;
  • Conhecimento em controles internos, COSO e SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley);
  • Atuação em projetos de auditoria e/ou consultoria;
  • Realização de auditorias de contratos - contratação, mediação e treinamento;
  • Realizar a revisão dos processos de negócios priorizados, identificando áreas de risco e oportunidades de implementação de auditoria contínua;
  • Documentar a especificação funcional dos testes a serem desenvolvidos pelo time técnico.

Experiências Necessárias

  • A partir de 3 anos em Auditoria Interna.
  • Vivência em empresas do setor elétrico.

Formação Acadêmica

  • Ensino Superior Completo. Área de formação: Engenharia Elétrica.
  • Órgão de Classe Ativo.

Conhecimentos

  • Pacote Office.
  • Inglês Intermediário.

Habilidades e Atitudes Desejáveis

  • Visão analítica / crítica
  • Organização
  • Comprometimento
  • Confidencialidade

title: Camunda 8 Developer
description:
Corus Consulting is a consulting firm with more than 15 years of experience with different clients worldwide; we have presence in Europe, United States, Asia and Mexico.

We are looking for your talent to work as:


Camunda 8 Developer


About the role:

We are seeking a highly skilled Camunda Developer with knowledge in the 8th version, to join our team supporting a customer in the banking sector.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop new components, maintain and evolve existent ones according to the team priorities and product roadmap.
  • Active role on team software quality assurance, best practices and agile methodology.
  • Take responsibility of the software delivery by ensuring quality and scope expectations are met.
  • Work closely with partner technology teams and collaborate effectively.


Requirements:

  • Hand-on experience designing and implementing Camunda 8 BPMN processes.
  • Deep understanding of Java (11 or above) and Java Spring (4 or superior) and solid understanding of OO principles.
  • Solid experience Spring Boot.
  • Diligent with automated testing i.e. JUnit/Mockito/Cucumber, etc.
  • Understanding of RESTful API principles.
  • Proficiency in English (minimum B2).


Location:

  • Remote from Brazil.


Ready to bring your expertise to the next level? Apply now and join a team that's shaping the future of financial services.


Support the team and the Camunda Chapter!

title: Lead Software Engineer - AI
description:
Lead Software Engineer - AI



Job-Specific Responsibilities:

  • Develop production-ready software solutions that solve real business problems, considering business needs and technology/operations landscape; lead interaction with internal stakeholders and technology on specific projects and initiatives
  • Apply software engineering, data science, machine learning, and AI techniques to derive business value from the full range of internal and external data, leveraging Cloud-based technology
  • Design solutions, build initial code, and provide documentation with ways of working to minimize time to value and maximize re-usability
  • Translate complex data and methodology into strategic, operationally feasible insights and recommendations; automate implementation
  • Communicate clearly and effectively to technical and non-technical audiences, verbally and visually, to create understanding, engagement, and buy-in
  • Identify trends and opportunities to drive innovation, both in what we do and how we do it; evaluate new software engineering, data science, machine learning, and AI technologies and tools that can boost team performance, innovation, and business value
  • Manage, coach, and mentor a team of software engineers and data scientists, serving as a predominant technical expert
  • Actively contribute to and re-use community best practices
  • Build trust and collaboration by being present on-site and engaging directly with colleagues and various constituents.
  • This role is responsible for other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum of seven years’ post-secondary education or relevant work experience

Additional Qualifications and Skills:

Required skills

  • Bachelor’s/Advanced Degree in Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or 7+ years equivalent work experience
  • 3-5 years of experience in developing a variety of software products in a commercial environment
  • 2+ years of experience in building generative AI-based products.
  • Strong Python and Typescript/JavaScript skills required;
  • Expertise in multivariate statistical modelling (e.g., clustering, regression, principal components and factor analysis, time-series forecasting, Bayesian methods) and modern machine learning (ensemble methods, regularization, gradient boosting, representation learning, deep neural networks, transformers architectures, self-supervised learning, and MLOps fundamentals) required
  • Experience with cloud computing platforms (AWS, GCP, or other), or equivalent on-premise platform
  • Experience working in agile methodology is required
  • Prior experience in leading data science and machine learning based software development projects focused on solving business problems and seizing business opportunities

Desired skills

  • Proficiency in SQL desirable
  • Ability to mentor and lead others; provide hands-on technical guidance; conduct code reviews
  • Ability to simultaneously coordinate and track multiple deliverables, tasks, and dependencies across multiple stakeholders / business areas
  • Experience with deep learning and neural network architectures (e.g., CNNs, RNNs, transformers), including generative and self-supervised models, and with frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch is desirable.

Proficiency with data visualization tools is desirable

description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Legal Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $880-$1,440 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,760-$2,880 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $11 - $18 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.



Job Summary : The Legal Assistant will be responsible for providing comprehensive support to attorneys, performing legal research, drafting documents, and maintaining client files.


Job Tasks :


  • Legal Research and Documentation: Conduct legal research and prepare various legal documents.
  • Case Management : Manage and organize case files and documents.
  • Client Interaction: Communicate with clients for information gathering and updates.
  • Administrative Support: Handle clerical tasks, manage calendars, and answer phone calls.
  • Court Preparation: Help attorneys prepare for court by organizing documents and coordinating logistics.
  • Compliance and Reporting: Ensure legal compliance and assist in filing documents with courts.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream Job!

title: Senior Business/System Analyst (Disaster Recovery)
description:
Product Overview:

Vuori is re-defining what athletic apparel looks like: built to move and sweat in but designed with a casual aesthetic to transition into everyday life. Our high-energy, fast-paced office environment is reflected in the clothes we make. We aim to inspire others to take on all aspects of their lives with clarity, enthusiasm, and purpose…. while having a lot of fun along the way. We are proud to be an outlet for the opportunity of personal growth and success.


Overview

We are seeking a contract Business Analyst to support the development and execution of our Disaster Recovery (DR) Program. This role will help establish structure, documentation, and repeatable processes to ensure our DR efforts are organized, testable, and aligned with business needs.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop the overall structure and framework for the Disaster Recovery Program, including roles, responsibilities, and governance.
  • Create and refine documentation such as DR runbooks, process flows, and system recovery procedures.
  • Partner with technical teams to capture system dependencies, failover steps, testing requirements, and validation criteria.
  • Build templates, standards, and repeatable processes to drive consistency across DR documentation.
  • Coordinate project tasks, track progress, and support cross-functional alignment to ensure milestones are met.
  • Facilitate workshops and gather requirements from subject-matter experts.
  • Define DR test planning, evidence capture, post-test reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Ensure documentation aligns with internal standards and compliance requirements (e.g., SOX, SOC2).


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Program Coordinator, or similar role.
  • Experience supporting Disaster Recovery, Business Continuity, or technology resilience programs.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills with the ability to translate complex technical inputs into clear, structured outputs.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with infrastructure, applications, and security teams.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Confluence, Jira, Microsoft 365, and diagramming solutions.
  • Advanced spoken English level (B2–C1 or higher).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Azure, SaaS vendor DR models, or hybrid cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOX, SOC2, or ISO 22301.
  • Prior involvement in DR tabletop exercises


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), and a flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Partner Strategy & Management Manager
description:
At Keeta, we are building the future of food delivery in Brazil. As part of Meituan’s global ecosystem, our mission is clear: help people eat better and live better.


We are looking for a Partner Strategy & Ecosystem Manager to architect and scale our partner ecosystem. This is a strategic role responsible for designing commercial frameworks, performance systems, and lifecycle processes that enable partners to grow while strengthening platform performance.


About the Role


In this role, you will define how Keeta structures, incentivizes, manages, and scales Sales BPO. You will balance commercial objectives with partner enablement, ensuring sustainable growth across the marketplace.

You will act as the strategic bridge between partners and internal stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities


Partner Strategy & Process Framework

• Design comprehensive partner strategies, including commercial models and incentive structures

• Develop partnership economics that balance growth and profitability

• Optimize compensation and performance frameworks aligned with market dynamics


End to End Partner Lifecycle

• Build scalable onboarding, training, and enablement processes

• Define recruitment, evaluation, and transition standards

• Create structured frameworks for ongoing partner support


Performance Management & Execution

• Develop and implement partner performance evaluation systems

• Analyze performance results and drive improvement initiatives

• Translate strategic priorities into clear execution plans for partner managers


Settlement & Operational Excellence

• Execute partner settlement processes with accuracy and timeliness

• Identify opportunities to improve settlement efficiency and transparency

• Partner with Product to enhance systems and workflow automation


Requirements

• Experience in food delivery, e-commerce, marketplace, or on demand services

• Experience building scalable partner lifecycle processes

• Strong analytical skills with Excel, SQL, or BI tools

• Advanced English proficiency for cross border collaboration

• Availability to work on site in São Paulo


Why Join Keeta

• Shape the strategic foundation of Keeta’s partner ecosystem in Brazil

• High ownership and visibility from day one

• International exposure with global collaboration

• Startup speed combined with global scale support


If you are excited about building scalable partner ecosystems, designing commercial strategies, and driving marketplace growth, we would love to hear from you.

#Keeta #EatBetterLiveBetter #PartnerStrategy #Marketplace #CommercialStrategy #EcosystemGrowth

title: Support Specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands’ customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we’re just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub. 


Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!



About the opportunity

As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.

﻿ This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew. 




We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?



Key Responsibilities:
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
  • Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
  • Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
  • Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
  • Customer Support
  • Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
  • Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
  • Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
  • Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
  • Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Escalation Management
  • Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
  • Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.

    • Skills & Qualifications:
    • Technical Expertise:
    • Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications.
    • Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
    • Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
    • Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
    • Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
    • Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
    • Problem-solving Ability:
    • An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
    • Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
    • Communication Skills:
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
    • Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
    • Organizational Skills:
    • Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
    • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.



    Preferred Experience:
    • Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
    • Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
    • Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS).
    • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
    • Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
    • Previous work with an American company
    Education & Certifications:
    • Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
    • Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
**Please Read*

Duration: This is expected to be a 12 month engagement, potential for extensions

Location : Remote in Brazil

Notice Period: 3 weeks

Structure: CLT - this CANNOT be adjusted.

Pay: R$15,268 to R$20,000 monthly

Senior AI Back-End Engineer

Must Haves:

  • 1+ years of experience as an AI/ML Engineer
  • 2+ years of Python development experience, including API creation, model training, testing, and general backend programming
  • Familiarity with LangChain for building LLM workflows using tools, memory, and retrieval.
  • Strong communication skills – able to work independently while providing clear updates to the team

Plusses:

  • Familiarity with AWS infrastructure (IAM, VPC, S3, etc.)
  • Experience with OpenSearch
  • Experience with Airflow and understanding of data orchestration
  • Exposure to RAG architectures, especially visual RAG use cases

Day-to-Day:

We are hiring two AI/LLM Engineers (1 Mid-Level, 1 Senior) to join a small, focused team building backend features for an existing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) service. You'll work on extracting structured data from diverse content types—images, graphs, eBooks, journals, and more—using visual-based models. This role involves experimentation, model development, and comparing LLMs for visual RAG use cases. You’ll deploy code to non-prod environments and support production rollout in collaboration with the DevOps team. While primarily a heads-down, individual contributor role, clear communication and collaboration with the team is expected.

title: Consulting Partner
description:
ERA Group, a global leader in cost management and business optimisation, is looking for an entrepreneurial Partner to join our international network of consultants.

This is not a traditional consultancy role; it’s a chance to run your own practice within a global brand, with the freedom to shape your market, build your team, and grow your client base while backed by ERA’s proven methodologies, tools, and worldwide community.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead cost optimisation, procurement, and performance improvement programmes across industries
  • Build and grow your client portfolio through business development and long-term partnerships
  • Take ownership of your practice’s strategic direction, go-to-market approach, and team leadership
  • Work directly with C-level clients to deliver measurable savings and transformation


What You Bring

  • Extensive consulting or senior leadership experience in cost management, procurement, or performance improvement
  • A strong track record of client acquisition and project delivery
  • Deep expertise in one or more industries such as Pharma/Life Sciences, Energy/Utilities, Manufacturing, Consumer, or Logistics
  • Confidence in engaging with CxO-level stakeholders and leveraging your professional network
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with the ambition to grow a successful consulting practice



This is the ideal next step if you’re seeking less bureaucracy, more independence, and the chance to build something of your own within a global consultancy platform.


By applying, you agree to the use of your personal data for recruitment and related communications, in accordance with the UK GDPR.

title: Analista Funcional SalesForce Sênior
description:
A Foursys é apaixonada por inovação, design e transformação digital.

Somos globais. Somos GPTW. E somos movidos por pessoas.

♿


Na Foursys, acreditamos que diversidade é potência. Valorizamos diferentes histórias, ideias e perspectivas — aqui, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras. São parte do que nos fortalece.

Quer fazer parte do time e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent ? Então olha essa oportunidade


Sobre a oportunidade:

Atuar no time de CRM Systems (Salesforce) desenvolvendo e evoluindo soluções com foco em Service Cloud, garantindo qualidade técnica, aderência às boas práticas de desenvolvimento e integração com demais sistemas corporativos.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções em Salesforce Service Cloud
  • Implementação e evolução de Apex
  • Implementação e utilização de Platform Events
  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de Flows
  • Configuração e evolução de Omnichannel
  • Implementação de Bots
  • Participação nas cerimônias do squad em ambiente ágil (Scrum / Kanban)
  • Versionamento de código utilizando Git / GitHub
  • Integração e deploy utilizando Jenkins
  • Interação com áreas de negócio para entendimento das demandas
  • Contribuição com boas práticas de desenvolvimento e qualidade de código

title: Senior Node.js Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Node.js Backend Engineer

Contract: 12 months

Hours: UK/CET

Rate: $300 USD per day

Location: Fully Remote


Overview

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to take ownership of core platform services, helping evolve an existing AWS-based system into a more scalable, modular architecture. This is a hands-on product backend role with real responsibility over performance, reliability, and system design.


What you’ll do

  • Migrate existing serverless logic into a modular NestJS backend
  • Build and maintain backend services using Node.js, TypeScript, and NestJS
  • Lead MySQL / Aurora performance optimisation (queries, indexing, scaling, reliability)
  • Improve system scalability and stability across AWS infrastructure
  • Contribute to observability (Grafana) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform)
  • Work closely with product and engineering to ship high-quality backend features


Tech Stack

  • Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript
  • MySQL (Aurora), Redis
  • AWS (ECS, Lambda, SQS, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront)
  • Terraform, Grafana


Must have

  • 5+ years commercial backend experience
  • Strong Node.js + NestJS
  • Solid MySQL optimisation experience in production environments
  • Deep AWS hands-on experience
  • Comfortable using AI dev tools day-to-day (Copilot / Claude / similar)

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Software Backend - Sênior (Go & Type)
description:
O que você precisa para essa posição no jogo:

  • Conhecimento avançado em desenvolvimento em Golang ou Typescript ;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento de consumidores e produtores de eventos para Event Streaming (Kafka) ;
  • Conhecimento em Docker & Kubernetes ;
  • Conhecimento com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade ;
  • Conhecimento sobre testes unitários e de integração;
  • Preocupação com a qualidade e desempenho das soluções propostas;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente multifuncional e colaborativo, de maneira autônoma;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento e implementação de APIs ;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento de microsserviços distribuídos ;
  • Embasamento teórico, habilidade e preocupação com a excelência técnica e boas práticas de desenvolvimento (DDD, Arquitetura, Design de Código, Paradigmas, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis.


Seria legal se você conhecesse:

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento em C# ;
  • Google Cloud Continuous Integration;
  • Continuous Delivery.


O seu papel como Software Engineering Backend:

  • Desenvolver programação do início ao fim, incluindo definições de arquitetura, testes e rollout em produção;
  • Desenvolvimento de projetos com arquitetura de microserviços, consumo e geração de eventos em Streaming, API's;
  • Garantir a funcionalidade, manutenibilidade e velocidade, além de práticas de teste e qualidade;
  • Garantir que todas as soluções técnicas estejam alinhadas a estratégia do negócio e entender iniciativas relacionadas ao produto;
  • Ajudar o time no desenho de soluções com arquitetura evolutiva, além de investigar constantemente novas tecnologias e formas de trabalho;
  • Colaborar com a evolução das habilidades técnicas do time e esforços de melhoria contínua que impactam vários times;
  • Trabalhar em um ambiente colaborativo, em que práticas de pareamento, feedbacks e motivação para se desenvolver são comuns a todos os squads.

title: Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer
description:
Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

Our trusted high-growth technology partner is building a production AI platform that transforms disconnected data into measurable business growth. With customers already onboarding and the platform live in production, they are hiring a Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer to scale their next-generation AI systems.



Position Overview:


We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer to own the intersection of agentic AI and modern web development . You will build the intelligent backend powering a multi-agent system and the interactive frontend delivering real-time AI experiences . This role requires strong architectural judgment — the platform runs on Vercel , and decisions around caching, bandwidth, cost efficiency, and production reliability are critical.

If you are excited about building AI agents that work in production , designing streaming chat experiences , and solving complex orchestration challenges , this is the opportunity for you.



What You'll Do:


  • Design and optimize production prompts for LLMs and build multi-agent workflows with smart routing, specialization, and human-in-the-loop approval gates
  • Build stateful agent workflows with planning, execution, and observation loops — making sure agents reliably follow structured steps even when users go off-script
  • Create streaming chat UIs with real-time rendering, tool call visualization, and interactive artifacts
  • Connect agents to analytical databases for live data retrieval, SQL generation, and knowledge base access through RAG pipelines
  • Own performance across the full stack — caching strategies, bandwidth optimization, and keeping Vercel costs under control
  • Implement LLMOps practices including prompt versioning, observability, and cost tracking.



What You Bring


  • 3–5+ years of progressive experience in full-stack development.
  • Strong TypeScript skills across frontend, backend, and agent logic
  • Production experience with React or Next.js (App Router, Server Components, API routes)
  • Hands-on work with LLM agent frameworks — LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or custom agent loops
  • Production prompt engineering: system prompts, chain-of-thought reasoning, tool-calling patterns
  • Direct experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models)
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Vercel AI SDK (useChat, streamText, streaming patterns)
  • Familiarity with durable workflow engines like Trigger.dev or Temporal
  • Experience with RAG pipelines, vector databases, or knowledge retrieval systems
  • Background in performance optimization for Vercel-hosted applications
  • Experience at an early-stage startup or building a product from 0 to 1.



Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Arquiteto de IA
description:
Especialista em advanced Analytics atuará na definição e implementação de soluções com IA, sensoriamento remoto, geoprocessamento e análises espaciais, e na liderança técnica do time de cientista de dados.


Formação:

  • Graduado/Especializações em Matemática, Ciências Exatas, da Terra, Sensoriamento Remoto, Tecnologia da Informação e afins.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de soluções de advanced analytics.
  • Domínio de técnicas e métodos aplicados de advanced analytics (ML, DL, LLM).
  • Experiência em sistemas de informação geográfica, sensoriamento remoto, geoprocessamento e análises espaciais.
  • Domínio nas principais técnicas de Feature Enginnering, modelagem com Machine Learning e melhores práticas de MLOps.
  • Proficiente em ciência de dados, otimização, aprendizado de máquina, Python, SQL, análise de dados e habilidades analíticas.
  • Trabalho em equipe e habilidades de comunicação.
  • Capacidade de análise crítica para análise e definição de solução.
  • Capacidade de aferir a qualidade da entrega através de testes.
  • Conhecimentos em geoprocessamento e sensoriamento remoto.
  • Competências GEO e análise espacial.
  • Conhecimentos na plataforma ArcGIS.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Compreender as necessidades do negócio, fornecer insights acionáveis e recomendações com base nas análises e traduzi-las em requisitos técnicos e proposta de solução.
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências e avanços na área de ciência de dados.
  • Aplicar técnicas de reconhecimento de padrões, incluindo, mas não se limitando à visão computacional, redes neurais convolucionais (CNN), modelos de linguagem para processamento de linguagem natural (NLP), Large Language Models (LLM) e análise de dados e análise preditiva (ML).
  • Aplicar técnicas de sensoriamento remoto para definição de soluções de mapeamento de uso e cobertura do solo através da visão computacional para interpretação de imagens de satélite e/ou radar.
  • Promover a viabilidade técnica da proposição de modelos de machine learning, atuando em parceria com cientistas de dados na elaboração e construção de soluções.
  • Atuar como líder técnico do time de ciência de dados para discussões e direcionamento técnico, planejar, preparar, treinar e direcionar a equipe do projeto às melhores práticas de ciência de dados.
  • Testar e validar soluções de ciência de dados para garantir sua eficácia, qualidade e atendimento aos requisitos.
  • Engajar o time e promover debates construtivos, extraindo informações, conhecimento e potencial de um grupo em torno de um objetivo em comum ou resultado maior.
  • Ajudar os times a aumentarem a produtividade, obterem melhores resultados, resolverem problemas organizacionais complexos, responderem rapidamente as mudanças e a fortalecer a sua cultura organizacional.
  • Conduzir discussões técnicas e processos de ideação / inovação. Criando um espaço e um ambiente de confiança, liberdade e troca, propício à criatividade.


Por que escolher a Geosistemas?

Saúde e Bem-Estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico - Sul América.
  • ✅ Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais.
  • ️ ♂️ Acesso ao Gympass para cuidar do corpo e da mente.

title: Arquiteto de softwares sênior
description:
Arquiteto de softwares sênior

Requisitos Obrigatórios

Inglês Avançado

Experiência profunda em design de sistemas, com conhecimento em padrões arquiteturais como Microserviços, Event Driven, Serverless e Monólitos Modulares.

Essencial possuir domínio avançado em AWS, Azure ou GCP, focando em otimização de custos e alta disponibilidade. Proficiente em linguagens como Java, Go, .NET ou Python, com entendimento sobre quando utilizar bancos SQL vs NoSQL.

Conhecimento sólido em DevOps e Observabilidade, incluindo esteiras CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes e ferramentas de monitoramento como Prometheus, Grafana e ELK.

Implementação de práticas de Security by Design, OAuth2 e LGPD são imprescindíveis.

Requisitos Desejáveis

Um histórico de contribuições em projetos Open Source e certificações de prestígio, como AWS Certified Solutions Architect.

Experiência com Domain Driven Design (DDD) é um plus.

Possuir habilidades de liderança e estratégia, incluindo o poder de articular conceitos técnicos complexos para stakeholders não técnicos.

Capacidade de mentoria e de elevar o nível técnico dos desenvolvedores plenos e seniores é desejada.

Pragmatismo e foco na entrega de valor são valorizados, assim como habilidades na resolução de conflitos técnicos entre equipes.

Resumo dos requisitos: Design de Sistemas, Microserviços, Event Driven, Serverless, Monólitos Modulares, AWS, Azure, GCP, Java, Go, .NET, Python, SQL, NoSQL, DevOps, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Security by Design, OAuth2, LGPD, Open Source, Domain Driven Design (DDD).

title: Engenheiro(a) de Software Mobile - Sênior (Flutter)
description:
O que você precisa para essa posição:


Formação Acadêmica

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou experiência prática equivalente.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar na construção de uma arquitetura mobile escalável e de fácil entendimento;
  • Atuar na identificação e correção de bugs e comportamentos não desejáveis;
  • Acompanhar de forma ativa a saúde das aplicações mobile utilizando-se de métricas e relatórios;
  • Colaborar de forma ativa junto às squads no planejamento, desenvolvimento e entrega de novas funcionalidades;
  • Escrever cenários de testes automatizados buscando uma cobertura de testes ampla e confiável;
  • Trabalhar de forma contínua na identificação de melhorias e otimizações de performance;
  • Zelar pela qualidade das aplicações mobile junto às lojas;
  • Zelar pela segurança das aplicações mobile.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos utilizando Flutter;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicativos nativos (Android com Kotlin/Java e/ou iOS com Swift/Obj-C) ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos utilizando gestão de estados no padrão Bloc ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos com Arquitetura Limpa ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em testes unitários, integração, instrumentados e E2E ;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos modulares/multi-lib ;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de design systems ;
  • Experiência com diferentes Arquiteturas e Padrões de Projetos;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com análise e monitoramento de erros de aplicativos em produção ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com processo de releases nas lojas de aplicativos Google Play/Apple Store;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com desenvolvimento e automação de esteiras de delivery .


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com frameworks e padrões de segurança, como OWASP, NIST, ISO/IEC 27001 e em programa de Security Champions.


E aí curtiu?

Inscreva-se e faça parte do nosso time!

title: Especialista em Java (Tech Lead)
description:
Somos o Grupo Casas Bahia, com mais de 70 anos de história, realizando os sonhos de +100 milhões de brasileiros.


Aqui, somos protagonistas o tempo todo, sempre com integridade e ética em tudo o que fazemos. A paixão pela nossa gente é o que nos move, e a dedicação total ao cliente é o nosso compromisso diário. Entregamos resultados e buscamos sempre a simplicidade em tudo o que fazemos!


Estamos buscando uma pessoa para atuar 100% de forma remota, integrando o time de Tecnologia como referência técnica da squad de backend. Será responsável por liderar tecnicamente o time, definir padrões de desenvolvimento, promover boas práticas e garantir a qualidade, escalabilidade e resiliência das soluções construídas.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Liderar tecnicamente a squad de backend, servindo como referência para o time.
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores juniores e plenos, promovendo evolução técnica contínua.
  • Definir padrões de código e arquitetura, garantindo qualidade, escalabilidade e resiliência das soluções.
  • Realizar code reviews estruturados.
  • Definir backlog técnico e quebrar épicos em tarefas técnicas claras.
  • Conduzir refinamentos técnicos e apoiar na priorização de débitos técnicos em conjunto com o PM.
  • Garantir cobertura de testes (unitário e integração) e aplicação de boas práticas de versionamento (GitFlow ou trunk-based).
  • Aportar e disseminar conhecimento técnico na squad, evoluindo a maturidade do time.
  • Atuar como elo de contato entre a squad e outras equipes técnicas do Grupo Casas Bahia (Arquitetura, Engenharia de Software e SRE).


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Forte capacidade de mentoria e comunicação clara e didática.
  • Capacidade de delegar tarefas conforme a maturidade do time.
  • Liderança pelo exemplo (hands-on) e capacidade de dar feedback construtivo.
  • Organização, disciplina técnica, paciência e facilidade de se relacionar com pessoas.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis: Agile, Scrum e Kanban.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em Java 11 ou superior, Spring Boot e APIs RESTful (OpenAPI / Swagger).
  • Experiência com JPA/Hibernate, microsserviços e arquitetura orientada a eventos (EDA).
  • Conhecimento em Design Patterns, Clean Architecture, SOLID e DDD (Domain-Driven Design).
  • Experiência com Kafka (produção, consumo, particionamento, DLQ, retry).
  • Experiência com Kubernetes (preferencialmente AKS).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL, incluindo PostgreSQL, SQL Server, SOLR, MongoDB e Redis.


Informações adicionais:


Local de Trabalho: Brasil | Remoto.


Confira alguns dos benefícios incríveis que preparamos para garantir seu bem-estar e qualidade de vida:


  • PLR/Bônus : Um reconhecimento extra para valorizar o seu esforço e dedicação!
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica : Para que você tenha toda a segurança e cuidado com a sua saúde e a da sua família.
  • Vale Refeição : Porque sabemos que uma alimentação de qualidade é essencial para o seu dia a dia! ️
  • Seguro de Vida : Tranquilidade e proteção para você e seus entes queridos.

title: Especialista em Java (Tech Lead)
description:
Somos o Grupo Casas Bahia, com mais de 70 anos de história, realizando os sonhos de +100 milhões de brasileiros.


Aqui, somos protagonistas o tempo todo, sempre com integridade e ética em tudo o que fazemos. A paixão pela nossa gente é o que nos move, e a dedicação total ao cliente é o nosso compromisso diário. Entregamos resultados e buscamos sempre a simplicidade em tudo o que fazemos!


Estamos buscando uma pessoa para atuar 100% de forma remota, integrando o time de Tecnologia como referência técnica da squad de backend. Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Liderar tecnicamente a squad de backend, servindo como referência para o time.
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores juniores e plenos, promovendo evolução técnica contínua.
  • Definir padrões de código e arquitetura, garantindo qualidade, escalabilidade e resiliência das soluções.
  • Realizar code reviews estruturados.
  • Definir backlog técnico e quebrar épicos em tarefas técnicas claras.
  • Conduzir refinamentos técnicos e apoiar na priorização de débitos técnicos em conjunto com o PM.
  • Garantir cobertura de testes (unitário e integração) e aplicação de boas práticas de versionamento (GitFlow ou trunk-based).
  • Aportar e disseminar conhecimento técnico na squad, evoluindo a maturidade do time.
  • Atuar como elo de contato entre a squad e outras equipes técnicas do Grupo Casas Bahia (Arquitetura, Engenharia de Software e SRE).


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Forte capacidade de mentoria e comunicação clara e didática.
  • Capacidade de delegar tarefas conforme a maturidade do time.
  • Liderança pelo exemplo (hands-on) e capacidade de dar feedback construtivo.
  • Organização, disciplina técnica, paciência e facilidade de se relacionar com pessoas.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis: Agile, Scrum e Kanban.

description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


**Please note that we're aiming at an expatriation to Portugal**


We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of “large company” in 2018. We now have more than 350 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria , as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. Working with Affinity is a “Lifetime Experience ” where you will have the opportunity to demonstrate all your potential and to be successful on every level.


#welcometoyourfuture


What you need to have

  • College degree in IT Engineering or similar areas;
  • At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in Java programming language ;
  • A strong experience with front end technologies (Angular OR React.JS for example)
  • Experience with microservice architecture and cloud is a BIG plus;
  • Experience with Spring frameworks;
  • Good level of English (minimum B2 level)
  • Availability to relocate and live in Portugal with our support;


What we expect from you

  • Will to exceed expectations (your own and the ones defined by Affinity);
  • Exceptional skills and the will to acquire more;
  • Good people skills (not just in terms of technology, language, and platforms), team spirit, and pleasant disposition;

What will encourage you

  • Being part of a company that has a disruptive action in the technology market;

  • Accessing a generative career directly proportional to your performance and interest;
  • The real possibility of being part of our company staff.

title: Servicenow Developer
description:
ServiceNow Developer | 100% Remote | Enterprise Projects

Are you interested in working on complex ServiceNow projects with real integrations and frequent production deployments? This opportunity is for you.

This role is primarily a ServiceNow Developer position within an enterprise environment, working in an Agile pod (SAFe) delivering high-impact solutions on the ServiceNow platform.

Key Responsibilities

  • Development and configuration within ServiceNow (Client Scripts, Business Rules, Script Includes, Workflows, Flow Designer).
  • Building scalable solutions and integrations (REST/SOAP, MID Server, authentication).
  • End-to-end participation in user stories: design, development, testing, and deployment .
  • L3 support , automation, and continuous platform improvements.
  • Collaboration with ITSM, ITOM, and Event Management teams .

About Slack (Realistic Expectation)

Slack is NOT the primary focus of the role .

The expectation is to:

  • Support or maintain existing apps and workflows.
  • Assist with integrations (often triggered from ServiceNow).
  • Perform light automation or behavioral adjustments.
  • Understand how Slack integrates into enterprise workflows.

A profile with experience working with APIs, integrations, webhooks, bots, or collaboration tools (Teams, Slack, etc.) can adapt quickly.
company: Microtalent is becoming INSPYR Global Solutions

title: Angular Developer  - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • 6+ years of professional experience as Angular Developer;
  • Experience with the latest versions of Angular;
  • Experience with TypeScript;
  • Fluency in English (mandatory);
  • Interest in working from Portugal (mandatory).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote based in Portugal/on-site.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV!

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!



Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.

For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority –

title: Supervisor de Produção- Estocagem e Expedição
description:
O Grupo Zanchetta é referência nacional na Indústria e processamento de aves e bovinos.


Buscamos profissionais para compor nossa equipe de Expedição para nossa unidade na cidade de Batayporã - MS.


Responsabilidades:

•Planejar, organizar e supervisionar as atividades dos setores de paletização, estocagem, expedição e túnel de congelamento.

•Coordenar as operações de expedição, incluindo o carregamento de produtos e roteirização de entrega e alocação e recursos;

•Manter registros precisos de todos os envios, documentação de transporte e relatórios de desempenho de equipe;

•Garantir que todos os produtos sejam manuseados e embalados de acordo com os padrões de qualidade da empresa;

•Acompanhar a programação de produção da área, repassando as informações à Supervisão;

•Controlar os horários de refeição e pausa de colaboradores, a fim de evitar atrasos e interferência na produção;


Requisitos:

•Formação superior em Engenharia da Produção, Logística ou afins;

•Conhecimento em pacote office;

•Conhecimento e experiência em frigorífico;

•Residir em Batayporã ou Nova Andradina/ MS.

description:

Somos o grupo educacional mais diversificado do país. Todos os dias, criamos futuros incríveis através da inovação. Colocamos a mão na massa para tirar as ideias do papel e colocá-las em prática. Enfrentamos desafios com resiliência e nos adaptamos às mudanças constantes.


Por aqui, somos um time e não heróis, guiados pela vontade de fazer a diferença e conectados de um só jeito, o #JeitoCogna. Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso.

Se você busca desenvolvimento e crescimento profissional , essa é a sua chance. Acreditamos no seu potencial e queremos investir na sua carreira!

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development at Healthcare Head Office


Perseus Group is a major Operating Group of Constellation Software (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus Group has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, located in over 40 offices.


The Role

Perseus is growing the Business Development team within our M&A group. This role will be primarily focused on covering the Brazilian software market. The successful candidate must be based in Brazil.

The role is to build strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. Relationships will be formed with decision makers (i.e. CEOs/VPs of Corporate Development/founders/owners) of software companies globally, M&A advisors, and private equity/venture capital professionals. Success is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships, having clients sign LOI’s and ultimately, the acquisition of software companies/assets by Perseus/Constellation.

Initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately being considered and chosen to be acquired by Perseus/Constellation typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/relationships and high-quality market research is what ultimately generates successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s)
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.
  • Have a meaningful impact on Perseus Group over a successful tenure in-role


Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • Experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role or, prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.
  • Full fluency in Portuguese and at least professional-level fluency in English are required, Spanish fluency is a plus.
  • This role will require occasional in-person travel and can be primarily performed either Remotely within Brazil or from a Hybrid-Sao Paolo, Brazil office.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) FrontEnd Pleno | Plataforma
description:
A Plataforma desenvolve produtos que sustentam experiências digitais essenciais dentro do ecossistema Sankhya, com foco em reutilização, escala e qualidade.

A missão desta posição é construir interfaces frontend modernas e reutilizáveis , contribuindo para a evolução técnica do time e para uma experiência consistente e escalável.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver interfaces frontend com foco em reutilização
  • Atuar com arquitetura de Micro Front-End
  • Criar e customizar componentes em Design System
  • Trabalhar com Web Components
  • Integrar interfaces com serviços backend
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares
  • Propor melhorias técnicas e de usabilidade
  • Utilizar ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial no dia a dia de engenharia para apoio em diagnóstico de problemas, revisão de código, documentação técnica e aceleração de entregas, garantindo uso responsável e seguro das informações.


Requisitos

  • Experiência com React
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de Micro Front-End
  • Vivência com Web Components, preferencialmente Stencil
  • Experiência com Design System e componentes reutilizáveis
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração
  • Versatilidade técnica e proatividade


Procuramos profissionais que gostem de construir soluções escaláveis, trabalhar de forma colaborativa e evoluir tecnicamente em um ambiente com autonomia e impacto real. Se você se identifica com esse contexto, queremos te conhecer.


LOCALIDADE

Uberlândia/MG – Presencial

São Paulo/SP – Híbrido (2x/semana no escritório)

Outras localidades – Remoto


BENEFÍCIOS

Remuneração Variável + Participação nos Resultados (PPR)

title: Data Scientist - Remote - Talent Pool
description:
We’re building a talent pool for Senior Data Scientist Engineers . This pipeline role is for engineers with strong SQL and Python experience . This position plays a key role in supporting product decision-making through data analysis, reporting, and business intelligence.


What You’ll Do

  • Help clear existing backlog and enhance the team’s data infrastructure and analytics capabilities.
  • Work with ETL processes, analytics , and BI tools to drive actionable insights.
  • Create and maintain data pipelines and workflows using Airflow .
  • Perform data cleaning, transformation, and combination of existing data tables in Snowflake .
  • Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to deliver accurate reporting and analytics .
  • Contribute to Streamlit dashboards and analytical tools.


What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience with Python and SQL in a data-focused environment.
  • Familiarity with data tools such as Airflow , Snowflake , and Streamlit.
  • Strong understanding of analytics best practices and product data workflows.
  • Basic knowledge or interest in cryptocurrencies, blockchain technology, and ERC-20 tokens.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.
  • Ability to work effectively across time zones with overlap to US hours (preferably Eastern Time).


Nice to Have

  • Prior experience in fintech, payments, or digital assets.
  • Understanding of blockchain data structures or related crypto analytics .

Kake is a remote-first company with a global community — fully believing that it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. The icing on the Kake:

Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally.

Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you.

Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions.

title: AI Specialist Engineer
description:
✨ Seu talento impulsiona o nosso futuro


A Getnet é uma empresa global de tecnologia especializada em soluções de pagamento para o comércio. Fundada no Brasil e presente na América Latina e na Península Ibérica, apoiamos mais de 1,3 milhão de comerciantes com serviços completos — da maquininha ao e-commerce.

Fazemos parte da PagoNxt , a fintech global do Grupo Santander, e atuamos como um hub de adquirência com forte presença em Espanha, Portugal, Brasil, México, Chile, Argentina e Uruguai .

Nossa missão é clara: simplificar os pagamentos com inovação, segurança e escala , ajudando negócios de todos os tamanhos a crescer com agilidade.

Oferecemos uma plataforma unificada que integra hardware, software, prevenção à fraude, adquirência, conciliação e serviços financeiros — tudo em um só ecossistema, para que nossos clientes possam focar no crescimento do seu negócio.

Fazer parte da Getnet é se juntar a uma empresa que combina a inovação de uma fintech com a solidez de um banco global.


Imagine your future. Care for your career. Simplify your journey.


Isso significa que você terá a chance de construir soluções de impacto, crescer com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e evoluir em uma cultura que valoriza bem-estar, inclusão e clareza.

Combinamos flexibilidade, autonomia e colaboração global — para que você possa focar no que importa, se conectar com propósito e ajudar a moldar o futuro.

Aqui, você vai encontrar espaço para crescer, oportunidades reais para liderar e uma cultura onde todas as pessoas pertencem e contribuem.


✨ Se você quer fazer parte da próxima geração de soluções financeiras, este é o lugar certo.

Já te imagina sendo Nxter?


Atuar na definição, implementação e evolução da plataforma de IA Generativa da companhia. Será responsável por desenhar arquiteturas avançadas de GenAI e Agentic AI, estabelecer padrões corporativos, definir protocolos de comunicação entre agentes (A2A) e liderar a adoção de protocolos modernos de IA Generativa, como o Model Context Protocol (MCP), garantindo escalabilidade, segurança, governança e eficiência operacional em nível enterprise.


O que vai fazer

  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura corporativa de GenAI, garantindo alinhamento estratégico, independência de fornecedor e uso em escala empresarial.
  • Projetar e implementar plataformas de agentes inteligentes, incluindo:

- Orquestração de agentes autônomos;

- Workflows multi-agente;

- Comunicação Agent-to-Agent (A2A);

  • Definir e padronizar protocolos de comunicação, coordenação e execução entre agentes, com forte adoção do Model Context Protocol (MCP) para gestão de contexto, memória e ferramentas.
  • Estabelecer padrões arquiteturais corporativos para:

- Ingestão, versionamento e governança de dados

- RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)

- Fine-tuning e adaptação de modelos

- Inferência, caching e otimização de custos

- Observabilidade de LLMs e agentes

  • Definir, implantar e evoluir práticas de LLMOps, abrangendo todo o ciclo de vida de:

- Modelos de linguagem

- Prompts

- Agentes

- Memória, contexto e ferramentas

- Avaliação contínua, versionamento, rollback e deployment

  • Definir e implementar guardrails corporativos, políticas de segurança, privacidade, compliance regulatório e governança de IA.
  • Avaliar, selecionar e recomendar frameworks, modelos (open-source e proprietários), padrões emergentes e abordagens arquiteturais para IA Generativa.
  • Garantir observabilidade ponta a ponta das soluções, incluindo métricas de qualidade, latência, custo, confiabilidade e experiência do desenvolvedor.
  • Atuar ativamente em fóruns de arquitetura, influenciando decisões estratégicas de tecnologia e inovação.
  • Contribuir com código de alta complexidade, revisões técnicas, definição de padrões e mentoring de engenheiros.

✅ O que buscamos em você

  • Experiência como Software Engineer Specialist, GenAI Engineer, AI Engineer ou Arquitetura de Plataforma/Soluções, com forte foco em IA Generativa.
  • Domínio avançado em IA Generativa e LLMs, incluindo:

- Prompt engineering avançado

- RAG em escala corporativa

- Fine-tuning e adaptação de modelos

- Avaliação automática e humana de LLMs

  • Forte experiência em arquiteturas de agentes autônomos, incluindo:

- Agentes multi-step e multi-agent

- Comunicação A2A (Agent-to-Agent)

- Planejamento, raciocínio, memória de curto e longo prazo e execução

  • Conhecimento profundo em protocolos de IA Generativa.
  • Experiência prática com LangChain, LangGraph ou frameworks equivalentes de orquestração de agentes.
  • Experiência sólida com microserviços, APIs REST e arquiteturas distribuídas.
  • Vivência com containers, orquestração de workloads e Infraestrutura como Código (IaC).
  • Experiência em observabilidade, incluindo logging estruturado, tracing distribuído, métricas e controle de erros.
  • Conhecimento sólido em segurança da informação, identidade, controle de acesso, criptografia e proteção de dados.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.

✅ O que pode contar pontos a mais

  • Profundo domínio de Python, incluindo:

- Construção de frameworks e SDKs internos

- APIs síncronas e assíncronas

- Pipelines distribuídos e event-driven

- Boas práticas de engenharia de software e testes


O que oferecemos
